segments.text: Ok so, this is the authentication page in the CopilotKit docs, for AG2, and I have implemented this page in my project.
This is my project, and this is the exact code from the doc, the frontend setup and the self hosted chat endpoint.
Moving on to the demo. Umm, I sent a message asking for the account data, and the chat just stayed empty, no reply at all.
So here the doc passes the token in properties, and says it gets forwarded to the chat endpoint as a request header.
Basically, the header never reaches the backend. The backend log shows four oh one unauthorized on every run, so uh, following this page you can't get an authenticated run at all.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
